keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. Infobox "Geographical range: Shandong"; "about a dozen sites are associated with the culture, and five have been excavated" (Xihe, Xiaojingshan, Qianbuxia, Yuezhuang). No area; the province is the placement.

ledger.note: 6000 BCE: the Houli millet and rice villages hold Shandong (the culture "c. 6500 - c. 5500 BC" began before the project's first year).
5500 BCE: the Houli culture ends ("c. 6500 - c. 5500 BC", "Followed by: Beixin culture"); the Beixin begins in 5300 on its own page, leaving Shandong empty for two centuries.

certainty.note: No border is recorded; the culture is known from a dozen sites.

notes: Houli culture of Shandong; infobox 'c. 6500 - c. 5500 BC', so it began before the project's first year and the dossier starts at -6000. Extent: the page gives only 'Geographical range: Shandong' and names the excavated sites Xihe, Xiaojingshan, Qianbuxia and Yuezhuang ('about a dozen sites ... five have been excavated') without placing them, so the whole province is drawn (confidence 2); it overstates a culture of a dozen sites. The Yuezhuang millet is 'dated to around 8000 BP' and the rice to '8010-7700 BP' (not drawn). Gap: the Beixin page dates the Beixin to 5300-4100 BC and the Houli to 6500-5500 BC, so Shandong has no culture 5499..5301; both dossiers keep the pages' dates and the 200 years stay blank (nobody's land) rather than being bridged from memory. No predecessor on the page (the infobox field is empty). No area figure to compare.
